decisions.reason: As a charting plugin tightly linked to the firm's web-GIS platform knowledge and iterative release capabilities, it remains easier to improve and integrate than to abandon.
The mobile layer-control component addresses a recurring usability need in the firm's existing customer base and fits its strong geospatial UX and application-development know-how.
The GIS solution platform is a strategic flagship built directly on the firm's core architecture, R&D, and standards-related capabilities, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
Mobile field data capture is a close adjacent application of the firm's established geospatial integration expertise and offers continued scope for learning from customer deployments.

The search extension is close to the firm's installed web-map knowledge base and can still be refined through platform integration, though as a narrower add-on it has slightly higher pruning risk than the core products.
